subject.title: feat(gateway): add context engine control API

question: Should OpenClaw expose context-engine capabilities, status, doctor, and rotate as a core Gateway/plugin control API after the session-targeting blocker is fixed?
rationale: The mechanical canonicalization bug is clear, but the PR creates a public Gateway HTTP surface and optional ContextEngine plugin contract with operator/admin control semantics that require maintainer API intent.

options.title: Approve after scoping fix
options.body: Keep the proposed core API direction, but require canonical session targeting, regression tests, branch refresh, and maintainer-reviewed scope/docs semantics before merge.

options.title: Narrow the control surface
options.body: Land only read-scoped capabilities/status/doctor first and defer admin rotate until maintainers are ready to own that operator action.

options.title: Defer the core API
options.body: Pause or close the PR if context-engine maintenance control should stay plugin/private until a broader Gateway control contract exists.

recommendation.title: Approve after scoping fix
recommendation.body: Keep the proposed core API direction, but require canonical session targeting, regression tests, branch refresh, and maintainer-reviewed scope/docs semantics before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision crosses Gateway/session ownership and plugin API shape, and current helper history points to steipete on the relevant session-store boundary.
